01

The hero and widgets add early load

Mobile scored 37–40/100 with 6.68–7.72-second lab LCP, a 474 KB building hero, a 486 KB YouTube player and 2.69 seconds of reCAPTCHA CPU in one run.

  • Use a quality-preserving mobile hero and add high priority to its existing preload; keep first-screen styles and script dependencies intact.
  • Load the welcome video and lower-page form widgets more selectively using supported methods, while preserving CAPTCHA, forms and tracking.
02

The business schema uses an old type

Eight business blocks use the deprecated Attorney type instead of LegalService.

  • Change only @type from Attorney to LegalService on the homepage and blog archive pages 1–7 through the existing emitter.
  • Keep accurate business IDs, address, phone, split hours and the separate Organization, WebSite and FAQ blocks.
03

Floated images squeeze mobile text

Four pages squeeze mobile text into a 24px column, and three area introductions also confuse the Redding office with served cities.

  • Stack image and text on the three area pages and California workers-comp guide; preserve desktop and the working back-injury page.
  • Correct only the three office/landmark sentences with the existing location owners; keep approved legal copy and regional-page plans.

04

One old sitemap submission is missing

The old sitemap.xml.gz submission returns 404 while the current XML index and two working aliases still resolve correctly.

  • Confirm the gzip feed is retired, then remove only that obsolete Search Console submission; restore valid gzip XML only if still required.
  • Keep sitemaps.xml, sitemap_index.xml and the HTTP sitemap.xml alias unchanged.

Fix order

Prioritize verified loading costs, coordinate location wording with assigned work, and make the small schema/feed cleanup.

  • Website: quality-preserving hero and safe video/form loading; keep approved CAPTCHA, routing and legal copy.
  • SEO: narrow LegalService migration and retired-feed confirmation, without new indexing or duplicate location tasks.

Lab speed is not a field verdict. Existing area-page work, legal copy, CAPTCHA and phone tracking are preserved; full context is in the wider report.
